abilities.description:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.

Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.

Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.

en.description: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
en.name: Lavos
en.passiveDescription:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.

abilities.description:
施放一次毒蛇猛击，通过消耗目标的生命值来治疗 Lavos。

长按来为所有技能注入<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

布下一枚探头，来把生命球和能量球转化为可提供这两种补给的通用补给球，也可把弹药拾取物转换为通用弹药拾取物。探头也会电击近距离的敌人。每击中一名敌人，其它技能的冷却时间减少 1.5 秒。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

从 Lavos 体内迸发出催化探头，并把炽热的凝胶泼向对手。敌人身上每有一种元素异常状态，该技能的伤害便翻倍一次。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

zh.description: 当 Lavos 转化战场时， 他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用毒素、冰冻、电击和火焰来造成元素伤害。掌控黑暗炼金术士的力量。

en.description: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
en.name: <ARCHWING> Elytron

abilities.description: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。

abilities.description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate attackers and reduce their Armor.
Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak points to everyone in your squad.
Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies, limits their perception and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks, and renders them unable to activate their abilities.
Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground in a targeted area.

en.description: Banshee's call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
en.name: Banshee
en.passiveDescription: Banshee pierces the ears of enemies within a |RADIUS|m radius when casting Abilities, applying max <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status Effect. Additionally, Banshee's weapon noise is hushed.

Banshee 的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。
使用静音会使 Banshee 笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。
Banshee 将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动目标区域的地面。

zh.description: 在往事如烟的时代，据说山脉是战士的容身之所。在这个时代，山脉已化身成战士。

abilities.description: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.

Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.

Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.

Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.

en.description: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
en.name: Xaku
en.passiveDescription: |CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.

abilities.description: 技能激活期间，所有装备的武器都会造成 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。
虚空卷须偷取附近敌人的武器，以作为自己的浮空自瞄武器来使用。伤害输出会根据敌人等级增加。抢到的武器数量也决定了「失落之技：否认」的虚空射线的伤害倍数。
循环切换三种失落之技。「指责」幻化出虚空裂缝，来让敌人堕落成为友军。「凝视」通过虚空卷须抓住目标，并在目标被释放时，捕捉伤害并对目标造成伤害。「否认」通过一束虚空能量来进行湮灭攻击，并消除 Sentient 抗性。
Xaku 的外层结构在毁灭性的爆炸中暂时舍弃，然后以全新的的骨骼形态疾步潜行于战场。受到 Xaku 身体碎片击中的敌人会更难抵御 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。在超维炼狱施放期间，Xaku 其他主动技能的持续时间将会冻结，技能终止时恢复。

zh.description: 漂浮在虚空中的破碎战甲汇聚在一起，形成了 Xaku。他们齐心协力，造成高额的伤害。Xaku 证明了合力的力量胜过单独的力量。

zh.passiveDescription: 在受到范围攻击时，减免 |CHANCE|% 的伤害，并有几率避开武器伤害。

Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.

en.name: Qorvex
en.passiveDescription: Weapons wielded by Qorvex have an additional +|PUNCH_THROUGH| Punch Through.

abilities.description: 召唤出一根辐射柱体来减速敌人。它会造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害且必定触发异常状态。

保护自己和附近的友军免受异常状态影响。Qorvex 每次击杀或协助击杀受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射状态影响的敌人时，辐量防护可以阻止的异常状态数量会增加。
从 Qorvex 的堆芯中释放光束。对命中的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害，且必定触发异常状态。命中受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态影响的敌人会引发链式反应爆炸。

zh.description: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计 Qorvex，是为了防止被选中的指挥官受到其实验室中特殊风险的危害。堆芯赋予了 Qorvex 群体控制的能力，从而使其具有强大的生存能力。

en.longDescription:
Three figures waited behind a simple table. Their attention on a single chair, bathed in light. An old woman's voice from the shadow: 'Send her in'. Across the room a security officer, stern and plain, opened the door. The outline of a young woman appeared at the door. She hesitated, but only for an instant, then crossed the room and sat.

There was a gasp as the light hit her face. Her right eye was bright and blinking, but her left was a greasy slit. Her skin had been burned moon-white. Her mouth was a sagging gash without lips or expression. Her military beret was pulled snug over a scarred and hairless scalp.

The old voice: 'Your name is Kaleen.' Kaleen nodded. 'You were the principal investigator of the Zariman?' Kaleen's voice was a jagged whisper, a rigid face. 'Yes.'

Kaleen coughed, straightened: 'The Zariman was lost making the fold from Saturn to the Outer gates. Mechanical failure. I notified families and filed a report with the inspectors. Nothing ever returns from the fold, so I closed the case.'

'But you reopened the case, days later.'

'I didn't believe it myself until I stepped aboard the ship. It was completely intact, full environmental, as if it had never left.'

'And the crew was gone.'

'Not exactly.' Kaleen hesitated. 'We thought it was empty but we began to find...' Her face twitched at remembered pain, 'We began to find children hiding in the ship.'

'And that is when you violated procedure?'

Kaleen bowed her head, a tear welling in her sightless eye. 'They were children. They were afraid. They needed comfort.'

'So you broke quarantine and this happened to you.'

There was silence as Kaleen touched her face, 'So what have you done with them?'

The old woman gestured for the officer to take Kaleen away. The meeting was over. When Kaleen reached the door she twisted out of his grip and shot back, 'Why would you do that? Why would you put children on a military ship?'

'We didn't. That would violate procedure.'

zh.longDescription:
三道人影在一张简单的桌子后方等待着，他们的目光停留在一张沐浴于光照中的椅子上。一个苍老女人的声音从阴影中传来: '送她进来。'一个警卫穿过房间，神情严肃而直接的打开了舱门，一名年轻女子的轮廓出现在门后。她迟疑了一下子，但只有一瞬间，旋即走过房间坐了下来。

当光线打在她的脸上时，周围倒抽一口气而响起了一阵惊呼。她的右眼明亮闪烁，但左眼却有着一道沾满油污的伤痕，她的皮肤被烧到裸露，露出了惨白的皮层，她的嘴上没有类似嘴唇的东西，看起来像是一个下垂的裂缝。她的军用贝雷帽盖住了她伤痕累累，毛发全无的头皮。

那苍老的声音说:'你的名字是 Kaleen。'Kaleen 点了点头。'你是「扎里曼号」的主要事故调查员？''是的。'Kaleen 的声音听起来像是锯齿般沙哑的声音，神情僵硬。

Kaleen 咳了一声并清清喉咙，'「扎里曼号」在从土星到外环闸口的折越间失踪了，是机械故障。我已经通知了所有船员的家人，也递交了一份报告给监察员。没有任何东西从折越中出来，所以我结了案。'

'但你在几天后却重启了调查。'

'在我踏进那艘船之前我也不敢相信。那艘船完好如初，就好像它从未消失过一样。'

'但是船员都消失了。'

'并不完全是。'Kaleen 犹豫着，然后接着说：'我们本来也以为船上是空的，直到我们陆续发现………'她的脸因为那个痛苦的回忆而抽蓄着，'我们陆续发现一些孩子还躲在那艘船上。'

'于是你就违反了操作规程？'

Kaleen 垂下来头，泪水从她那只失明的眼睛夺眶而出，'他们只是孩子啊，他们很害怕，需要有人安慰。'

'所以你违反了隔离规定，导致你现在变成这个样子。'

当 Kaleen 触摸她的脸庞时，气氛瞬间陷入一片死寂。'你对他们做了什么？'

苍老的女人用手势示意警卫把 Kaleen 带走，本次会谈结束了。Kaleen 被带到门前时，她挣脱了警卫的束缚，并回头大喊：'你们为什么要这么做？为什么要把孩子放在军舰上？'

'我们并没有这么做。那会违反规定。'

zh.longDescription:
三道人影在一张简单的桌子后方等待着，他们的目光停留在一张沐浴于光照中的椅子上。一个苍老女人的声音从阴影中传来: '送她进来。'一个警卫穿过房间，神情严肃而直接的打开了舱门，一名年轻女子的轮廓出现在门后。她迟疑了一下子，但只有一瞬间，旋即走过房间坐了下来。

当光线打在她的脸上时，周围倒抽一口气而响起了一阵惊呼。她的右眼明亮闪烁，但左眼却有着一道沾满油污的伤痕，她的皮肤被烧到裸露，露出了惨白的皮层，她的嘴上没有类似嘴唇的东西，看起来像是一个下垂的裂缝。她的军用贝雷帽盖住了她伤痕累累，毛发全无的头皮。

那苍老的声音说:'你的名字是 Kaleen。'Kaleen 点了点头。'你是「扎里曼号」的主要事故调查员？''是的。'Kaleen 的声音听起来像是锯齿般沙哑的声音，神情僵硬。

Kaleen 咳了一声并清清喉咙，'「扎里曼号」在从土星到外环闸口的折越间失踪了，是机械故障。我已经通知了所有船员的家人，也递交了一份报告给监察员。没有任何东西从折越中出来，所以我结了案。'

'但你在几天后却重启了调查。'

'在我踏进那艘船之前我也不敢相信。那艘船完好如初，就好像它从未消失过一样。'

'但是船员都消失了。'

'并不完全是。'Kaleen 犹豫着，然后接着说：'我们本来也以为船上是空的，直到我们陆续发现………'她的脸因为那个痛苦的回忆而抽蓄着，'我们陆续发现一些孩子还躲在那艘船上。'

'于是你就违反了操作规程？'

Kaleen 垂下来头，泪水从她那只失明的眼睛夺眶而出，'他们只是孩子啊，他们很害怕，需要有人安慰。'

'所以你违反了隔离规定，导致你现在变成这个样子。'

当 Kaleen 触摸她的脸庞时，气氛瞬间陷入一片死寂。'你对他们做了什么？'

苍老的女人用手势示意警卫把 Kaleen 带走，本次会谈结束了。Kaleen 被带到门前时，她挣脱了警卫的束缚，并回头大喊：'你们为什么要这么做？为什么要把孩子放在军舰上？'

'我们并没有这么做。那会违反规定。'

en.longDescription:
The Sentients had won. They had turned our weapons, our technology, against us. The more advanced we became, the greater our losses. The war was over unless we found a new way. In our desperation we turned to the Void. The blinding night, the hellspace where our science and reason failed.

We took the twisted few that had returned from that place. We built a frame around them, a conduit of their affliction. Gave them the weapons of the old ways. Gun and blade. A new warrior, a new code was born. These rejects, these Tenno, became our saviors. Warrior-Gods cast in steel and fury striking our enemies in a way they could never comprehend.

Excalibur was the first.

-Orokin 'Warframe' Archives

我们接收了从那里归来稀少而扭曲的生物。在他们的身上铸造了外装甲，提供宣泄苦痛的管道，给予他们古老形式的武器，枪械与刀具。一种全新的战士，新的法则诞生了。这些被遗弃者，这些 Tenno，成为了我们的救世主。这些钢铁铸成，宛如神一般的战士，对我们的敌人以他们前所未见的方式施予狂怒的打击。

Excalibur 正是首位战士。

abilities.description: 放置一根天线向前发射扫描波。被探测到的敌人会受到更高的弱点伤害，并可透过墙壁被看到。武器获得穿透。

彰显力量与勇气。跃至空中并连续投掷崇敬标枪。标枪无论是否落地都可以对附近的敌人造成伤害。直接命中敌人将造成更高伤害。

zh.description: Styanax 从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。重装步兵可造成高额伤害。在他的长矛和盾牌的威力下，敌人闻风丧胆。
zh.name: Styanax
zh.passiveDescription: Styanax 的暴击几率随着他的护盾量而提升，标枪武器可获得双倍增益。

abilities.description: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.

Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.

en.description: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.
en.name: Styanax Prime
en.passiveDescription: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.

abilities.description: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.

en.description: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
en.name: Nidus
en.passiveDescription: If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.

abilities.description: 地面瞬间迸裂出有害的菌状生长物，从被击中的每个敌人身上吸取能量。每击中五名敌人便会使感染突变，倍化其破坏力。
生成一个迸裂出卷须的感染荚囊，紧抓附近的敌人并把他们拖入其中。在此期间被杀死的敌人有几率产生一层突变适性。
以寄生链接绑定目标。施展对象为友军时，Nidus 与宿主的技能强度和武器伤害都会提升；连结至敌方时，宿主可为 Nidus 承受部分伤害。
异常贪婪的蛆虫群包围敌人并据以为食，直到敌人被「致病力」命中并在身上爆发感染为止。突变适性对蛆虫有增益效果，而每击中一名敌人会增加突变适性的累积。

zh.description: Nidus 从感染者中获得力量，以此造成高伤害和提供群体控制，增强了其生存能力。给你的敌人带来瘟疫吧。
zh.name: Nidus
zh.passiveDescription: 如果 Nidus 在被击杀时拥有至少 |STACKS| 层突变适性，那么这 |STACKS| 层突变适性会被消耗掉；同时 Nidus 会获得 |DURATION| 秒无敌时间并恢复 |HEAL|% 的生命。

abilities.description: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.

Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.

en.description: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
en.name: Follie
en.passiveDescription: INKBLOT: Follie's abilities coat enemies in ink that slows their movement by |SLOW|% for |DURATION|s. Afflicted enemies have a |CHANCE|% chance to drop Health and Energy Orbs.

abilities.description: 穿过墨色框架，在目标地点以无敌的飞溅的墨汁出现，对附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

将 Follie 绘影集中的绘影图变为具有战术优势的道具。绘影图生成时会向附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

长按可打开绘影图轮盘。
绘制墨像来吸收 Follie 和友军所受的伤害。下方墨池挥洒出墨蚀效果。击杀墨池内的敌人可使 Follie 的墨像及墨池的规模不断扩大。
将附近的敌人绑在漂浮的气球上，气球会向他们喷洒墨蚀。戳破气球，敌人会坠落到地面，飞溅的墨汁会对附近的敌人造成伤害。

zh.description: 欢愉而可怕的绘影者 Follie 赋予墨水生命。她能通过千变万化的素描与戏法来支援小队，并控制敌群。
zh.name: Follie
zh.passiveDescription: 墨蚀：Follie 的技能使敌人身上沾满墨水，使其移动速度减缓 |SLOW|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。受墨蚀效果影响的敌人有 |CHANCE|% 的几率掉落生命球和能量球。

abilities.description: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.

Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.

en.description: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
en.name: Hildryn
en.passiveDescription: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.

abilities.description: 蓄力并迸发毁灭性的闪电。
掠夺邻近敌人一定比例的护盾与装甲，用以补充自身的护盾与超载护盾。这也会移除 Hildryn 和她队友的异常状态。
在友军周围创造一道护盾光环。敌人会在靠近 Hildryn 时受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。
升上天空并对敌人降下野火火箭。附近的敌人会被炸向空中，且每隔数秒就会在他们身上生成一颗能量球。当护盾耗尽后敌人将被摔回地面。

zh.description: 强韧就是 Hildryn 的长处。Hildryn 可从吸收自身护盾以提供能量给技能所用，同时能量亦可再次充能护盾。Hildryn 证明了优秀的进攻就是最佳的防守。
zh.name: Hildryn
zh.passiveDescription: Hildryn 的满护盾保险时间很长。在她的护盾耗尽后，她在 3.5 秒内免疫伤害。

abilities.description: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.

Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.

Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.

en.description: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
en.name: Nyx
en.passiveDescription: Nyx gains +|CRITICAL|% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per Confused enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range, up to +|MAX|%.

abilities.description: Nyx 控制目标的思想，迫使他们为 Tenno 效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当 Nyx 射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。
Nyx 释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给 Nyx。
Nyx 释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。
Nyx 吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。

zh.description: Nyx 的精神攻击使她成为一个危险的对手。她通过触及敌人的意识来进行群体控制，并将他们的攻击转向他们自己。这种操纵可以扭转战局。
zh.name: Nyx
zh.passiveDescription: Nyx 的 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内每有一个困惑的敌人，就会为她的主要武器和次要武器增加 |CRITICAL|% 暴击几率。最高增加 |MAX|% 暴击几率。

abilities.description: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.

Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.

en.description: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
en.name: Khora
en.passiveDescription: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.

abilities.description: 在欲聋的鞭打声中将敌人击退。装备在「长鞭利爪」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。
使用活性金属来束缚住一名倒霉的目标，并将缠绕过度靠近的敌人。以长鞭利爪击打可以刷新陷阱来捆绑更多敌人。
命令薇娜丽专注于一名目标；按住技能来切换攻击，保护和治疗形态；若薇娜丽阵亡，使用此技能可以立即复活她。

en.longDescription:
Warframe Archive - Debrief excerpt:

We sat strapped in, safeties off, waiting for the punch. Waiting for death. Through my filthy porthole I saw stars among the outlines of the other Splinter ships queuing for the Solar Rail. It would soon grip us with an incomprehensible power and cast us through the void into the mouth of our enemy.

I watched the ships one-by-one bending and gone. Each crammed with zero-tech soldiers sucking stale air, white knuckling their percussion rifles. Each filled with a desperation that comes from extinction. Our ship would be the last to cross the gap. Our ship had special cargo.

It was essentially empty. Just ten men, like me, strapped in with the best zero-tech suits and weapons the empire could build... and 'it'. 'It' stood in the aisle, a slender and eyeless metal form. A Tenno inside its Warframe. Vaguely human, vaguely feminine. Was this armor or some ornate carapace for the monster that lived inside? I strained against the harness as the ship yawed for final approach. I could see the Tenno standing there freely. Solemn and gold-gleaming, oblivious to the inertial force.

I had been, until then, a Tenno denier. They were ghosts, propaganda, twisted casualties of the void era. Not possibly real. Yet here it was in the flesh. The Empire, in their desperation, was going to turn the demons loose and hope for the best. Who did we fear more, the enemy or this monster? We had our safeties off, could we trust it? Then it didn't matter anymore. The punch came - and our windows became blinding. When we could see again our ship was somewhere else, shattered and dead in an instant.

My lungs were flattened, eyes full of death. Ship debris glittered like a night snow. The alien blue star was dark and blinding beyond us. The countless articulating worm-ships of our enemy, ringed in glowing discs, undulating and heat-bursting the surviving soldiers like me. This is where I died. I was caught in R-disc, sweeping over my right side and setting my blood on fire. My vision flattened, the hearing muffled and buzzed. I could feel the side of my face going slack and wet.

I was in a dying dream. I saw a bright spot blurring and weaving toward me. I felt a tug toward it from the metal clasps on my suit. It reached me, rising up - a gleaming metal beast, a plume of golden wings rising and unfolding behind it. An angel. It snatched me from my death. I could feel my lungs fill as it wrapped me in its wings. Its Void Shield shimmered blue, strained under the enemy beams. I felt a sudden tug of acceleration. I closed my eyes and held on like a child.

I awoke on the floor, the sting of crisping flesh on my face and side. It was standing over me, the wings gone. I heard the cracking of weapons echoing down the corridor. Maybe the mission would be saved, but I was dying and so I waved my hand to send it away. I felt a pistol thrust in my hand as I was heaved to my feet. The angel had saved me, pulled me from hell, but it would not pity me. I was to die on my feet, by its side. I turned my good side toward the gunfire and raised the gun. It nodded, its outstretched metal hand surging and pulsing in ancient shapes as blue shimmered around me. It turned, drawing its blade and together we surged headlong into the hailstorm of death and fire that awaited us.

战甲档案 - 问讯摘录：

我们坐着并被金属带扣住，关上了枪的保险，等待着传送，也等待着死亡的来临。透过肮脏的舷窗，我从其他分队船舰列队进入星际轨道的轮廓间看到了星辰。它很快就会用无止尽的力量吞噬我们，并借由虚空将我们扔进敌人的嘴中。

我看着这些船舰一艘接着一艘弯曲，然后消失，每艘船上都载满了呼吸着混浊空气的低科技士兵。他们脸色苍白地紧握撞击式步枪，每个人脸上都写着来自灭亡的绝望。我们的船会是最后跨越那道裂口的，因为船上载着特别的货物。

实际上船内空荡荡的，只有十个人，像我一样被束缚在只有帝国才能建造出的一流零式科技装甲与武器上…

而'它'呢，站立在通道中。一个身材曼妙，没有眼部的金属外型，一名着装了战甲的Tenno。似乎是个人类，还隐约散发出女性的气息。这套该称为防具还是华丽盔甲的东西里头住的是怪物吗？当船舰逐渐偏向最终航线时，我紧张地靠着挽具，我能看到那名Tenno不受拘束的站在那里，庄严并散发金光，丝毫不受惯性影响。

在那之前我一直以来都是个Tenno否定者。我认为他们都是鬼魅，是宣传，是虚空时代扭曲的伤亡者，不可能是真的。然而，它们现在活生生站在我眼前。这座帝国在深陷绝望之际，一股脑让这些恶魔倾巢而出，以期会有一丝好的结果。到底是谁比较可怕，是敌人还是这些怪物呢？我们把枪的保险关了，我们能信任它吗？然而一切都不再重要，灾难降临了-窗户变得炫目而难以见物，当我们的视力恢复时，我们的船舰已经身处某个地方了，震撼与灭亡在顷刻间蜂拥而来。

我的肺部被压得喘不过气，眼中所见尽是死亡。船舰的残骸如夜晚的雪一般闪耀着，天蓝色的外星球漆黑得几乎令我们伸手不见五指，敌方数不清的虫型战舰连接在一起，对和我一样幸存的士兵发出环形炙热的圆盘，波形攻击与热能冲击。这就是我死去的地方了，我被环形圆盘击中，它横扫过我的身体右侧，我感到体内的血液被烧得沸腾，视力丧失，耳边只能听到低鸣和嗡嗡作响的声音，我能感觉到我的脸庞湿润而松垮。

我做了一场关于死亡的梦。我看见一个模糊的亮点迂回地靠近我，接着意识到制服上的金属钩环被猛力一拉。它伸手抓住我，缓缓升起-一个微光闪亮的金属怪物，向上展开了它背后的一对金色羽翼。它宛如天使，将我从死亡中拯救而出。当它用羽翼包覆住我的时候，我再次感受到的肺部的脉动，再度充满了空气。它的虚空护盾闪烁着蓝色的微光，阻绝了敌人的激光攻击。突然间我感到一阵猛力加速，我像个孩子般被抱住，阖上了双眼。

我醒来时发现自己躺在地板上，脆化的皮肉刺痛了我的脸颊与侧身。它站在我面前，翅膀已经消失了。我听见火力交锋的声响在走廊回荡，或许任务还有机会达成，但我就快要死了，所以我挥了挥手跟它道别。在我奋力搬动我的双脚时，一把手枪被塞进我的手里。这名天使救了我，把我从地狱中拉了回来，但是它并不会因此怜悯我。我的脚已经废了，无法再站立，于是我把身体没有受伤的那一边朝向交火的方向，然后举起手枪。它点点头，张开金属的手，汹涌崩腾着的远古气息，就和当时环绕我的蓝色微光一样。它转过身去，拔出剑，我们一起投身那等待着我们，由死亡和火焰交织的风暴之中。

zh.description: 猴族战士力拔山兮气盖世。Wukong 能够造成巨大的伤害并具备强大的生存能力。他灵活多变的恶作剧战术让人难忘。
zh.name: Wukong
zh.passiveDescription: 在承受致命伤害后，Wukong 会自动使用他所掌握的其中一种保命神技。每次任务中，这些神技只能发动三次。

abilities.description:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.

Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.

en.description: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.
en.name: Wukong Prime
en.passiveDescription: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.

abilities.description:
Wukong 拔出一根毫毛，以此来制造出一个共同作战的分身。本体使用远程攻击时，分身就会发动近战攻击，而当本体拔出刀剑之时，分身则会进行掩护射击。
再次使用技能即可命令分身对某个目标发动强化攻击。
化身为一团云雾，飘过战场，在令沿途的敌人陷入眩晕的同时治疗 Wukong 和他的分身。

Wukong 和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后 Wukong 会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，Wukong 还会得到额外护甲。
召唤出定海神针并释放猴王的怒火。

zh.description: 恶作剧战士提升到了他的最终形态。
zh.name: Wukong Prime

abilities.description: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.

en.description: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
en.name: Nekros
en.passiveDescription: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.

abilities.description: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。
将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。
亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。
召唤战死敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。

zh.description: 有一个收割者，他的名字叫 Nekros。他提供致命的群体控制。当 Nekros 从死者中召唤新兵时，昔日的敌人就会变成盟友。

zh.passiveDescription: 每当周围 |RADIUS| 米范围内有敌人死亡时，恢复 |HEALTH| 生命。

abilities.description: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.

Hurl a flaming ring that sets enemies ablaze making them vulnerable to any damage. Flaming enemies drop Restorative Orbs on death. Charge to amplify the power of the ring, and reactivate to instantly travel to the ring's location.
Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.
Impale nearby enemies on spears that erupt from the below. Activate again to slam surviving enemies back into the ground.

en.description: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
en.name: Nezha
en.passiveDescription: Slide |SPEED|% faster and go |RANGE|% farther.

abilities.description: 点燃一道火焰的路径，烧灼敌人并净化友军。传送时可在落地点产生火圈爆破。
掷出一个可点燃敌人的火圈，使敌人更易受到伤害。燃烧的敌人可掉落恢复球。蓄力可增强火圈的力量，再次激活技能可瞬间传送至火圈的位置。
制造出守护火环，对靠近的敌人造成伤害并晕眩。
用破地而出的长矛将附近的敌人刺起。再次使用技能可以将幸存的敌人猛拍回地面。

zh.description: 机敏善变的驭火行家保护无辜者。 Nezha 多面化的战术使他在伤害和提供群体控制时具有很高的生存能力。他的火焰是希望的号角。
zh.name: Nezha
zh.passiveDescription: 滑行速度加快 |SPEED|% 且距离增加 |RANGE|%。

zh.name: Nezha Prime
zh.passiveDescription: 滑行速度加快 |SPEED|% 且距离增加 |RANGE|%。

abilities.description: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.

en.description: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Ash Prime
en.passiveDescription: <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effects inflicted on enemies do |DAMAGE|% increased damage and last |DURATION|% longer.

abilities.description: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。
扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时 Ash 进入短暂的隐身状态。
瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为 Ash 恢复一部分消耗的能量。
将 Ash 的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过 Mod 来升级。

zh.description: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的 Ash Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

en.name: Ash

zh.name: Ash
zh.passiveDescription: 敌人受到的 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态会让伤害增加 |DAMAGE|% 且持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。

abilities.description: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.
Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.
Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko’s mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.

en.description: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
en.name: Nokko
en.passiveDescription: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.

abilities.description: 扔出一个周期性释放有毒孢子的蘑菇，对附近的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害和异常状态，同时使他们陷入睡眠状态。
释放一个可以发出放射脉冲波的复苏蘑菇，给予 Nokko 及其友军 <ENERGY> 能量，并在短时间内对技能强度施加增益。
恢复为菌宝形态，生成使 Nokko 快速愈合和加速的球体。在此状态下，Nokko 无法被选为攻击目标并且会逐渐恢复。
释放一个混乱的弹道蘑菇，会追踪敌人并在触碰目标后爆炸反弹。接触 Nokko 的任何蘑菇都会使其活化，脉冲频率翻倍。

zh.description: 和 Nokko 一起行动起来！这位年轻的守护者拥有强大的根系和各种古灵精怪的真菌，很快就会扎根在你的心里
zh.name: Nokko
zh.passiveDescription: 当 Nokko 受到致命伤害后会恢复为菌宝形态，其激活的蘑菇会发光，触碰后可使 Nokko 复活。生成的光球会有加速效果，但不会提供治疗效果。如果未能及时到达发光蘑菇，Nokko 将自动复活。

abilities.description:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.
Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.
Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.

Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.

en.description: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
en.name: Protea
en.passiveDescription: Every |CASTS|th Power Cast is granted +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength.

abilities.description:
投掷弧线飞行的手雷。

（轻按）破片漩涡
产生一道锋利无比的弹片漩涡。

（长按）护盾卫星
Protea 重设手雷，使其变为超载护盾充能器，以保护她自身、她的友军和同伴。当 Protea 的护盾被击穿时，一台守护她的卫星会被摧毁以加倍延长其最小护盾保险的无敌时间。
部署一个火炮单位来向其面向的敌人发射炸裂的等离子电浆。每击中一名敌人都会增加后续等离子攻击的威力。
部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。

放置一个「时泊之锚」后的一段时间，Protea 可以把这段时间回溯，来触发一个时空内爆。该内爆伤害会根据从 Protea 放置「时泊之锚」的时候起到回溯的时候为止，这段时间造成的伤害而增加。在此期间丢失或使用的任何物品都会被退还给玩家。
在「时泊之锚」被激活状态时死亡的话，启用回溯会使 Protea 回到过去，从而使其免于死亡。Protea 仍会处于击倒状态，而「时泊之锚」也会消失。

zh.description: Protea 对保护了如指掌。她庞大的武器库可以造成伤害并为友军提供支援。她甚至可以操纵时间本身。

zh.passiveDescription: 每第 |CASTS| 次施放技能可获得 +|STRENGTH|% 的技能强度。

abilities.description: Leap onto an enemy and pierce them with Oraxia's spider legs, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Enemies defeated by this attack have a chance to drop Health or Energy Orbs.
Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.

Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.

en.description: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
en.name: Oraxia
en.passiveDescription: Wall Latching grants Predator's Lurk, rendering Oraxia invisible for |DURATION|s.

abilities.description: 跳到敌人身上，用 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿刺穿他们，造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。用这个攻击击败敌人时，他们将有几率掉落生命球或能量球。
Oraxia 投掷一张蔓延的蛛网，将猎物困住。在不断扩大的蛛网中被捕住的敌人会被困在茧中，并使其受到的易伤效果增加。
Oraxia 向她前方发射一连串带刺的飞镖，并施加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态。中毒的敌人被击杀后会生成急行蛛。

展开 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿，开始狩猎。Oraxia 免疫异常状态并提升最大生命值。她的远程武器充满 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。击杀敌人会使其爆发 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素。

蛛丝游走：轻按冲刺即可跳跃至目标表面。

zh.description: 阴险优雅与致命多面性交织，进化为完美掠食者。恐惧之名，Oraxia。
zh.name: Oraxia
zh.passiveDescription: 壁面攀附可获得「捕食者的潜伏」效果，使 Oraxia 在 |DURATION| 秒内隐身。

abilities.description: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.

A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.
With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.

en.description: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
en.name: Baruuk Prime
en.passiveDescription: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.

abilities.description: 只处于没攻击时可闪避所有飞来的子弹。再使用一次可关闭该技能。
平静的波浪使敌人速度变慢直到陷入沉睡。被击伤而苏醒的敌人会感到困惑和迷失。短暂的健忘意味着所有醒来的敌人都会忘记沉睡之前所发生的任何事。
召唤一群环绕的匕首并寻找敌人的枪支，用小型爆炸来摧毁它们。与「巧躲」结合来使范围加倍。
随着他的「克制」被侵蚀，Baruuk 用「宁静风暴」来使拳脚作出强大的范围攻击。掌握风暴的每一刻会使他恢复「克制」。

zh.description: 那些破坏和平，以及耗尽这位不愿出手的战士克制力的愚蠢之人注定会灭亡。
zh.name: Baruuk Prime
zh.passiveDescription: 每当巧躲子弹，以及每当敌人被镇静或被离手戏法缴械时，Baruuk 的克制力就会逐渐被侵蚀，同时他内心的风暴也会愈演愈烈。随着克制力的下降，Baruuk 会逐渐提升对伤害的抵抗力，且至多能抵抗 |PERCENT|% 的伤害。

abilities.description: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.

A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.
With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.

en.description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
en.name: Baruuk
en.passiveDescription: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.

zh.description: 不可小觑波澜不惊之人心中的怒火。Baruuk 拥有出色的生存能力和群体控制能力。当忍无可忍之时，这位不愿出手的大师就会释放其内在的暴怒。
zh.name: Baruuk
zh.passiveDescription: 每当巧躲子弹，以及每当敌人被镇静或被离手戏法缴械时，Baruuk 的克制力就会逐渐被侵蚀，同时他内心的风暴也会愈演愈烈。随着克制力的下降，Baruuk 会逐渐提升对伤害的抵抗力，且至多能抵抗 |PERCENT|% 的伤害。

abilities.description: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.
Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.
Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.

Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally's attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.

en.description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
en.name: Dante
en.passiveDescription: Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by |CHANCE|% on fully scanned targets.

abilities.description: 翻开 Dante 的显赫典籍——夜枭，向他的敌人释放悲剧。
Dante 的活力之作赋予他和他的友军超宏防护，并恢复他们的生命值。
Dante 的诗句从周围敌人身上抽出血液，对他们造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 胜利：连续施放两个「明之诗句」能够振奋友军，为他们提供增加生命值并赋予超宏防护的增益效果。击杀和助攻会短暂恢复超宏防护。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 悲剧：连续施放两个「暗之诗句」能够攻击敌人。来自 切割、火焰和 毒素异常状态造成的持续伤害将累积成一次性的爆发。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 守词者：「明之诗句」后跟着「暗之诗句」，将以夜枭分身为友军提供支援。夜枭分身会与其指定友军同步进行攻击。
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 书页飞羽：「暗之诗句」后跟着「明之诗句」可召唤幽幽鹰扑向敌人，使他们易受触发几率和异常状态伤害的影响，并将敌人的攻击从友军身上转移。

zh.description: 知识探求者。历史守护者。莱弗博物馆传说的勇敢学者。Dante 创作神秘的诗篇来支援队友并摧毁敌人。
zh.name: Dante
zh.passiveDescription: 夜枭扫描目标，为资料库记录信息。攻击已完全扫描的目标时增加 |CHANCE|% 触发几率。

abilities.description: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies' Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.

Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.

en.description: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
en.name: Oberon
en.passiveDescription: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.

abilities.description: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。
圣化 Oberon 周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护 Oberon 及其友军免受异常状态影响。
生成一道保护光环，为 Oberon 及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。
将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为 Oberon 提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。

zh.description: 愈合和苦痛皆为 Oberon 所驱使。他对自然界的驾驭能够支援友军。朋友之福，敌人之祸。
zh.name: Oberon
zh.passiveDescription: 当 Oberon 拾取 <HEALTH>生命球时，他与 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围的友军获得正义否决，使玩家抵挡下一次受到的伤害。最多可叠加 |STACKS| 层。

zh.description: 以这帝王般庄严的森林庇护者维系平衡。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: Oberon Prime

abilities.description:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.

Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.
The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.

en.description: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
en.name: Kullervo
en.passiveDescription: Kullervo boasts +|EFFICIENCY|% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +|WINDUP|% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.

abilities.description:
（轻按）Kullervo 为重击进行蓄力，然后传送至他的目标身边并发动攻击。他那充满愤怒的集中力会暂时增加他的近战暴击几率。
（长按）传送至任何标记的地点。
Kullervo 用匕首包围自己。每一把击中敌人的匕首都会恢复他的生命值，但每一把未击中敌人的匕首都会攻击 Kullervo，对他造成少量伤害。Kullervo 拥有满生命值时，会在击中敌人时获得超宏防护。
Kullervo 发出一道诅咒束缚住敌人。当一个被诅咒的敌人受到来自他的伤害时，其他被诅咒的敌人也会受到相应的一部分伤害。
虚空以匕首雨的形式回应 Kullervo 的呼唤，向他的敌人倾泄。

zh.description: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。
zh.name: Kullervo
zh.passiveDescription: 当 Kullervo 使用任意近战武器攻击时，其重击效率 +|EFFICIENCY|%，并且重击准备速度 +|WINDUP|%。

abilities.description: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.
Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.

en.description: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Hydroid Prime
en.passiveDescription: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.

abilities.description: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。
用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。
从附近敌人身上掠夺护甲，并为你的技能和武器附加 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态影响的敌人将提供更多加成。
召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。

zh.description: 以这金银之王号令大海的怒涛。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: Hydroid Prime
zh.passiveDescription: 被 Hydroid 伤害的敌人更容易受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态的影响，首次触发降低护甲 |PCT|%。

zh.description: Hydroid 可以召唤海洋深处的力量。他通过水系攻击来提供群体控制。他的敌人将在水中消亡。
zh.name: Hydroid
zh.passiveDescription: 被 Hydroid 伤害的敌人更容易受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态的影响，首次触发降低护甲 |PCT|%。

abilities.description: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.
Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.

Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Weak Point kills produce extra energy.
Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Weak Point hits are amplified even further.

en.description: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.
en.name: Harrow Prime
en.passiveDescription:
Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.

abilities.description: 释放一道能量波动将敌人锁在原地。每一个被锁住的敌人都将强化 Harrow 的护盾。
牺牲一定护盾来提升装填和射速，同时将施加于敌人的伤害转化为 Harrow 和附近友军的生命。
将 Harrow 的能量导引至「聚能焚炉」以产生增幅效果。一旦导引完成，击杀敌人就会给予附近友军能量喷发。导引使用的能量越多，每个击杀获得的返还奖励就越高。弱点击杀可产生额外能量。

zh.description: 通过复仇来实现救赎。僧侣般的 Harrow 会增幅友军的杀伤力，为其提供支援。克敌制胜，超越自我。
zh.name: Harrow
zh.passiveDescription:
拥有双倍过载护盾容量。
任务开始时获得最大能量。

abilities.description: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.
Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.

en.description: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
en.name: Ivara Prime
en.passiveDescription: Senses nearby enemies within |RADIUS|m.

abilities.description: 循环切换并射击出四种战术箭矢之一。隐蔽会创造一个使 Ivara 和队友隐形的固定球体。悬丝则可形成一道滑索。喧扰会发出高频声波并吸引敌人。沉睡之箭能使附近的敌人陷入沉睡。
操控 Ivara 所发射出的投射物并引导飞向目标处。

召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。

zh.description: 像夜间的树林一样庄严与致命，这就是狩猎女王的终极形态。
zh.name: Ivara Prime
zh.passiveDescription: 侦测周围 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人。

en.description: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.

en.longDescription:
Red lights flashing on stark, white walls. Davis is running ahead of me, dropping his notes. We're running for our lives. The fear gives me a strange perspective - I'm out of my body. I've forgotten how I got here. I don't recognize this place.

Davis and I slam pinned against a cell door and he shouts at me. I give him a dumb look. I can't hear him, the sirens, anything, only the muffled throb of terror in my head. I turn away from Davis down the hall and I see it. The hulking mass, flickering red, glinting like steel and fresh blood. Its skin changes, flowing like mercury when I'm blinded by the sudden muzzle-flashes. They do no good. The beast surges forward and the security men become crimson mist and gore.

I'm a statue, a cornered animal. A gate opens inside me and recognition floods in. I have seen this monster before. I have cut its shell and eviscerated its brothers. I have given it pain and measured its response. I have crafted then rejected countless like it. But I've never seen this beast so close, without the shield, without restraints. I have never seen it... free.

I know I will die so I just watch with curious acceptance. The beast squats down, shovelling a heap of gore into its mouth. It is watching me with vague eyes, a sense of recognition, ancestral memory. It knows who I am and what I've done. It rears up like a bear and roars, shattering the lights and casting us into darkness. I can hear it lumbering toward me, its metal fingers rending the walls, but I know I am dead. I close my eyes and stand ready to pay.

I feel the pull on my arm and realize Davis got the cell open. He tugs me into the cell beyond and I fall on my back. I see Davis standing at the open door, waiting, as the monster tears towards us.

Suddenly I could live through this so I shout, 'Davis, close the goddamn door!' - But he shakes his head with eyes wide as moons. He shouts, 'Watch!' over the roaring and rending of metal.

Then silence. Davis is panting, laughing? The beast fills the doorway, inches from him, dripping in blood, but still without violence. It stands there, looking at its hands. Davis whispers, 'No one would have believed me.'

I crawl up the wall to stand, opposite the door. I've never seen this cell, a cold place with an array of shelves. A morgue? 'Where are we, Davis?'

'This is where they keep them. The ones from Zariman.' I'm thrown, what was the Zariman? The ship that never returned? 'Davis, what's going on?'

Davis turns to me a smile forming - 'What's going on is...' he turns back to the beast now silent and calm. '...big, fat promotions.'

zh.longDescription:
白色的墙面上，赤红色的灯光一明一灭规律地闪动着。Davis 跑在我的前方，他的笔记沿路散落，我们为了活下去而发足狂奔。恐惧让我产生了奇怪的感知-无法确实的控制自己的身体。我已经忘记自己为何会来到这里，也无法辨识这个地方。

我和 Davis 奋力推撞紧闭的舱门，他对我大喊，我却只能报以一个呆滞的眼神。因为我听不到他，也听不见警报或是任何声音，脑中只有因惊恐而轰隆隆地不停作响。我转身走下大厅，然后我看到了它。一只丑陋的庞然巨兽，摇曳的红光照在它身上，就像钢铁与鲜血般闪动着。当我因突如其来的枪口焰而目炫时，它的皮肤产生异变，流出水银般的物质。那只野兽扑向守卫，他们毫无招架之力，空气中溅起片片血花，化成了绯红色的血雾。

我动弹不得，就像被逼上绝路的动物。在我内心深处的某扇大门开启了，我猛然认出那头野兽，我曾经见过这种怪物。我剥去它的外皮并取出它兄弟的内脏，我对它施加折磨以测试它对疼痛的反应，我合成然后又丢弃了无数像它一样的生物。但是我从未如此靠近的看过这种野兽，没有防护也没有束缚装置。我从来没有见过…它恢复自由的样子。

我知道我难逃一死，于是索性求知地接收这一切。只见那头野兽伏蹲下去，以兽牙铲起肉块送入口中。然后它用混浊不清的眼睛凝视着我，一种既视感与来自祖先的记忆，它认出了我，它知道我曾经做过什么事情。它像熊一样用后脚站立，发出的嘶吼声震碎了灯具，让我们陷入黑暗之中。我能听见它沉重的气息迎面袭来，金属的指爪刮着墙壁，我想我死定了。我紧闭双眼，准备为此付出代价。

我感觉有人在用力拉着我的手臂并意识到 Davis 弄开了舱门。他奋力将我拖进舱内，我因为过于虚弱而跌坐在地上。我看到 Davis 站在打开的门边，等待着那只怪物前来撕裂我们。

突然间我察觉到一丝生机，于是我大喊：“Davis，快关上那道该死的门！”但是他摇摇头，眼睛瞪得和月亮一样大，吼道：“仔细看！”他的音量盖过了野兽咆啸与刮裂金属的声音。

然后，周围陷入一片死寂。Davis 在喘息，他是在笑吗？那头野兽整个身体卡在门口，与 Davis 只有一步之遥，淌着鲜血。它动也不动，不再肆虐了，它就只是立在那里，望着自己的脚掌。Davis 悄声说：“说出去一定没人会信。”

我扶着墙爬起来，背对着舱门。我从来没有看过这样的舱房，这冻得刺骨的地方有排成阵列的层架。这是停尸间吗？“我们在哪里，Davis？”

“这里就是他们存放他们的地方，那些来自「扎里曼号」的东西。”我被弄得一头雾水，怎么会是「扎里曼号」？那艘永远回不来的船舰？“Davis，这到底怎么一回事？”

Davis 带着笑容转向我，“你问怎么一回事……”他镇定自若地背对那野兽，“……那就是我们要高升了。”

zh.description: Inaros 统领着骇人的沙漠。他的生存之道如同赋予他力量的千变万化的沙漠。传说中的 Inaros 是恐惧的吞噬者。
zh.name: Inaros
zh.passiveDescription: 当 Inaros 受到致命伤害时，他会将自己封入石棺中，并化身为沙土攻击敌人，吸取他们的生命力来复活自己。

Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.

en.description: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.

en.passiveDescription: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last |DURATION|% longer.

zh.passiveDescription: 对敌人施加的异常状态持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。

abilities.description: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.
Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.

Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.

Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.

en.description: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
en.name: Caliban Prime
en.passiveDescription: Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.

abilities.description: 在旋转的死亡漩涡中向前冲刺。被击中的敌人会受到 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态的影响，使其更易受到其他所有异常状态的伤害。每击中一个敌人，可恢复一部分能量消耗，以及生命值和护盾。被 Sentient 之怒举起的敌人受到额外伤害。
猛击地面发射毁灭般的脉冲波。没有被最初的爆炸杀死的敌人会被无助地抛向空中，在短时间内受到放大的伤害。
在 Sentient 单位类型之间切换，然后将其召唤到 Caliban 的身旁。震荡使专注于原始近战伤害。直垂使擅长远程攻击并且能造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态。召唤使能召唤自己的唱鸣使，并为小队提供护盾保护。
将三股原始能量流汇聚至一个点上，引发巨大爆炸。这些能量流能剥离敌人的护甲和护盾，每个被击中的敌人都会在能量流汇聚时被引爆。召唤的震荡使可施放自己的迷你版融合打击。

zh.description: Caliban Prime 是为了庆祝奥罗金与 Sentient 之间短暂的和平而打造的，堪称真正的合璧杰作。双生王国的继承者，身披皇家之金崛起。

zh.passiveDescription: 经验分享范围内的队友受到伤害后获得最高 |PCT|% 对该种伤害类型的抗性。

abilities.description:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.

Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.

Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.

en.description: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.

en.passiveDescription:

（按住）切换至 Sirius 并使用「光之圣域」。

Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。

abilities.description:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. (HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.

abilities.description:

（长按）亚克什会守护 Voruna，提升她的异常状态抗性。

（长按）莱卡斯会守护 Voruna，提升她的重击效率。

打开一扇通往太阳的传送门，放出毁灭性的纯阳等离子光束。按住射击键会使伤害加倍，但同时也会增加能量消耗。当太阳之门持续攻击敌人时，会对敌人造成更多伤害。

zh.description: Wisp Prime 的镀金光彩萦绕在战场上。盟友也十分期待她的多维美貌。
zh.name: Wisp Prime
zh.passiveDescription: 在维度之间流动，Wisp 在空中时对敌人来说是隐形的。

abilities.description: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death's Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.

Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
When the Death Well fills, Sevagoth's Shadow form is ready to be released. Tear the enemy asunder with a collection of melee-focused abilities.

en.description: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.
en.name: Sevagoth Prime
en.passiveDescription: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.

abilities.description: Sevagoth 的幽影向外飞去来蹂躏路径上的敌人。幸存者会随时间流逝，受到来自「死亡收割」的伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。
向附近的目标种下死亡之种来汲取他们的生命力。收割已播种的死亡之种来引爆受影响的敌人，并按照他们生命值的百分比来造成范围伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。
召唤一道放射脉冲波，来诱捕敌人落入技能范围并使其减速，同时吸取他们的生命力并注入「死亡之井」。处在脉冲波范围内的友军每次攻击都会吸取敌人的生命值。
当「死亡之井」被注满时，将能够释放 Sevagoth 的幽影形态；并可使用一系列近战技能撕裂敌人。

zh.description: 镀金舵手从暴风雨中现身，他的身影吸引着注定悲怆的灵魂。
zh.name: Sevagoth Prime
zh.passiveDescription: Sevagoth 死亡时，会化身成 Sevagoth 的幽影；通过收集重建他的墓碑所需的灵魂来使他复活。

zh.description: Sevagoth 不再漂泊虚空，已经回归。他和他的幽影能够造成巨大的伤害，并具有极强的生存能力。他们通过收割那些迷途的灵魂来维持自身的力量。
zh.name: Sevagoth
zh.passiveDescription: Sevagoth 死亡时，会化身成 Sevagoth 的幽影；通过收集重建他的墓碑所需的灵魂来使他复活。

abilities.description:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.
Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.

en.description: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
en.name: Yareli
en.passiveDescription: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.

abilities.description:
生成五个主动寻找敌人并会在触碰时膨胀的水球，同时对受害者造成伤害并使他们无法移动。
被水球击中的敌人受到所有来源的伤害都会增加。
召唤浪漪珊瑚，这是一种浪涌中的可骑乘生物，也是 K 式悬浮板的灵感来源。浪漪珊瑚通过吸收大部分来袭的伤害从而保护 Yareli。
通过一把三刃环绕的水形之刃来撕裂敌人。
把敌人拖入一个毁灭性的漩涡中，然后用一股爆裂水压将他们炸飞。每个被困在漩涡中的敌人都会增加爆裂造成的伤害。

zh.description: 驭浪者可以在战场上释放出毁灭的洪流。Yareli 的水系攻击可对敌人造成高额伤害。驭浪而上，敌军溺亡。
zh.name: Yareli
zh.passiveDescription: 当 Yareli 移动超过 |TIME| 秒时，她的次要武器获得 +|CHANCE|% 的暴击几率。

abilities.description: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.
In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.

In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.

en.description: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.
en.name: Equinox Prime
en.passiveDescription: |PERCENT|% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and |PERCENT|% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.

abilities.description: 昼夜交替：〈黑夜形态〉暂时获得额外护盾和护甲；〈白昼形态〉暂时获得额外伤害和速度。
〈黑夜形态〉使目标敌人陷入沉睡；〈白昼形态〉对目标敌人造成更多伤害。
〈黑夜形态〉时降低周围敌人造成的伤害。〈白昼形态〉时则增加附近友军的技能强度。
〈黑夜型态〉在附近被击杀的每一名敌人都能使友军恢复护盾。〈白昼型态〉使附近敌人陷入 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，在〈黑夜型态〉时停用技能来为 Equinox 及友军恢复生命及护盾。在〈白昼型态〉时停用技能来释放出一波切割之力。

zh.description: 昼夜的最终平衡形态；行走于界线上的优美之型。

zh.passiveDescription: |PERCENT|% 的生命球会转化为能量，同时 |PERCENT|% 的能量球会转化为生命。
